title: Daandeeji Baɗa Ndiyam Deƴɗam
intro: Natal renndo inniraango wonaa wuro walla laamɗo, kono ko ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam ɗam nguurndam moofti. Ko aayeeji seeɗa tan ciftortoo ndee renndo, sahaa fof ina limtee e saliiɓe ardaade. Heɗto no ɓe kaaldirta e niɓɓere.
clues: Minen ko min renndo inniraango e nder Quraan, kono daartol amen timmungol ina heddii e sirlu.
En ciftortee ko sahaa kala e bannge yedduɓe, hono yimɓe Ad e Samud.
Min mbiyetee ko sahabaaɓe Ar-Rass, Ɓunndu ndu nguurndam amen haɓɓanoo.
En njeddii nulaaɗo nelanooɗo e men ɗoydagol laaɓngol.
En limtaama e ɓeen saliiɓe Nelaaɓe ɓe Alla neli ɓee fof.
En njokkondirii e kulhuli timmuɗi e kala yedduɗo hade men, halkaare ngam jaɓde men.

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
